title: The Tokens Strike Back: Safety-Aware Denoising with Directional Embedding-based Revision
abstract: arXiv:2610.17636v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The Safety-Aware Denoiser (SAD) is a recent, training-free, safety-guidance framework for text diffusion models. During inference, SAD steers text samples toward safe regions of the token probability space. In this paper, we propose $\mathit{SADDER}$ (Safety-Aware Denoising with Directional Embedding-based Revision), which improves the safety and quality trade-offs of SAD by exploiting a safety-guidance signal in the embedding (or activation) space for each token position, then updating the token positions using the SAD update rule multiplied by the guidance signal. This multiplication acts as a gating mechanism: tokens with a high unsafe signal are more likely to be modified during inference following the SAD update rule. However, such an update does not automatically preserve the conditional mean, i.e., the denoiser of a fixed target distribution. translated_title: 《Token的反击：基于方向嵌入修订的安全感知去噪》
translated_abstract: 安全感知去噪器（SAD）是近期针对文本扩散模型提出的一种免训练的安全引导框架。在推理过程中，SAD将文本样本引导至token概率空间的安全区域。本文提出了SADDER（基于方向嵌入修订的安全感知去噪），通过在嵌入（或激活）空间中针对每个token位置利用安全引导信号来改善SAD在安全性与质量之间的权衡，然后使用SAD更新规则乘以该引导信号来更新token位置。这种乘法运算起到门控机制的作用：不安全信号较高的token在推理过程中更可能按照SAD更新规则被修改。然而，这样的更新并不能自动保持条件均值（即固定目标分布的去噪器）。因此，我们在理论上推导出了新的逐位置目标分布，使得……
tldr: 本文提出SADDER方法，通过将嵌入空间中的安全引导信号作为门控机制来改进文本扩散模型的免训练安全去噪框架SAD，并从理论上推导出保持条件均值的新目标分布，从而改善了安全性与生成质量之间的权衡。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SADDER, which improves the training-free safety-guidance framework SAD for text diffusion models by using embedding-space safety signals as a gating mechanism for token revision, and theoretically derives new position-wise target distributions that preserve the conditional mean, achieving better safety-quality trade-offs.
